notes.title: Evil Awaits Patch 1.1.2 Sprint Additions, Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
[u][b]Sprint Additions[/b][/u]
- You are now able to swap between weapons whilst sprinting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/6315c8c6c6719ff3e30e78777afad6a341668e41.gif[/img]
- Sprinting will no longer interrupt reloading.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/3d431ffb36693e7100c4be62853321854b37cbce.gif[/img]
These additions to the sprint mechanic are actions in response to player feedback and overall feel like a nice quality of life in the tense combat moments of Evil Awaits.

[u][b]Fixes and Improvements[/b][/u]
- Fixed an instance that would cause the wrong weather values in the levels Garden and Cemetery.
- Fixed an instance that caused an extra pipe piece to spawn after solving the puzzle in the level Forest.
- Buffed the rate at which the boss can dodge in phase 2 of the level Cemetery.
- Improved materials for the boss in the level Cemetery.
- Improved lighting during the boss in the level Cemetery.
- Fixed an instance that stopped 3 Toolkits from appearing in the level Cemetery.
- Several Ui inconsistency improvements.

[u][b]Framework[/b][/u]
This update includes some new systems and framework that prepare Evil Awaits for soon-to-come new features.

[u][b]Thank You[/b][/u]
We are 3 more user reviews away from getting a Steam rating!
Thank you to everyone who has provided feedback and positive reviews, you're the best.

notes.title: Evil Awaits Patch 1.1.0 - New Upgrades, Boss Changes, and Big Improvements
notes.notes:
[u][b]Evil Awaits first major patch is here![/b][/u] 
This patch brings in new upgrades and journals, boss reworks, quality-of-life improvements, balancing and lots more.

[h1][b]New Upgrades[/b][/h1]
5 New Journals can be found throughout Archdale, all introducing new upgrades at the workbench. 

[b]Ammo Mule[/b] - Increase the amount of maximum ammunition for all weapons.

[b]Medkit Capacity[/b] - Increase the maximum amount of Medkits you can carry at one time.

[b]Medkit Strength[/b] - Increase the effectiveness of Medkits.

[b]Roll Distance[/b] - Increase the distance traveled whilst Rolling.

[b]Sprint Speed[/b] - Increase the speed of Sprinting.

[h1][b]Additions[/b][/h1]
- An additional 15 toolkits have been added around Archdale, and more can be found from specific sources.
- Headshots now have a high chance to stagger enemy variants that can be staggered.
- Loot drop system reworked for all lesser enemy variants.
- The ranking system has been re-balanced and now includes Journals found.

[h1][b]Bosses[/b][/h1]
[b]Bridge[/b]
- Slightly increased health across all difficulties.
- Slightly reduced health scaling.

[b]Docks[/b]
- Increased health during the second boss phase on Standard difficulty.
- Decreased chance of long spit attack during the second phase.

[b]Cemetery[/b]
- Changed behaviour during the first phase.
- Increased health to succeed during phase two on Standard and Hardcore difficulties.

[b]Archdale Castle[/b]
- New interactive objects added to the last boss room.
- Last boss reworked with additional animations for new environment interactions.
- Last boss health increased across all difficulties.
- Last boss movement speed increased across all difficulties.

[h1][b]Balance[/b][/h1]
- Slightly reduced health scaling of lesser enemy variants.
- Light Melee Damage increased from 20 - 25 -> 30 - 35
- Heavy Melee Damage increased from 25 - 35 -> 45 - 55
- Sprint Melee Damage increased from 25 - 35 -> 60 - 75
- More enemies spawn on Standard and Hardcore difficulties in the level: Garden.
- Rifle Max Ammo reduced from 120 -> 90
- SMG Max Ammo increased from 90 -> 120
- Sniper Rifle Max Ammo reduced from 30 -> 12

[h1][b]Improvements and Fixes[/b][/h1]
- The crosshair setting is now enabled by default.
- Once reaching the Chapel and beyond, the protagonist will now have a dirty/wet cosmetic effect.
- Sniper icon will now appear on the New Game menu when appropriate.
- Cinematics longer than 10 seconds are now skippable in the level: Archdale Castle.
- Both Ending credit screens can now be skipped.
- The Critical Multiplier upgrade now shows the correct information when fully upgraded.
- Journals no longer apply to Notes counted.
- Journals no longer apply to Note-related achievements.
- Fixed an instance that would disable controls after the opening boss cinematic in the level: Docks.
- Fast zombies will now drop Revolver ammunition instead of Pistol if it is equipped.

To celebrate Evil Awaits will be on its first sale since its release, starting today!
20% OFF From 21/11 - 04/12

Thank you to everyone who has played Evil Awaits, and provided positive reviews with feedback.
Look forward to more.

notes.title: Evil Awaits Patch 1.0.5 - Sprint Overhaul and Improvements
notes.notes:
[u][b]Sprint Changes[/b][/u]
- [b]Strafing and directional sprint[/b]
You can now move in all directions and freely rotate your camera whilst sprinting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/52efdc1e517c127f8b46f3b72287a53707714468.gif[/img]

- [b]Responsive Sprinting[/b]
Previously the player had to start moving in a direction to pick up the momentum for sprinting. This has now been adjusted so sprinting can happen from an idle position or any speed value.

- [b]Lean Animations[/b]
Lean animations have now been added to emphasize turns with the new sprint controls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/50d5ed22c34604690ce7e2d40e0ad61d6a09f6b3.gif[/img]

Reworking the sprint has been an effort of response to player feedback and I hope this along with previous patches will address the issues surrounding unresponsive controls.

[b][u]Fixes and Improvements[/u][/b]
- The ability to skip cinematics longer than 10 seconds has been implemented into the level: Docks.
- The ability to skip cinematics longer than 10 seconds has been implemented into the level: Cemetery.
- Several audio adjustments.

[u][b]More is on the way[/b][/u]
I am in the process of more fixes and improvements along with new features and in-game additions. Look forward to a lot more soon. 

Thank you for playing Evil Awaits!

notes.title: Evil Awaits Patch 1.0.4 - Brightness, Crosshair, More Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
[u][b]Additions[/b][/u]
- Crosshair has now been added and can be enabled/disabled from the 'Gameplay' section in the settings menu.
- Tips will appear during loading screens at the bottom of the screen.

[u][b]Several fixes and improvements[/b][/u]
- Sky brightness has increased by 20 - 25% in all levels.
- Adjusted audio locations for all Skulls Of Archdale to be easily heard when near.
- Fat mutation spit attacks have been slightly reduced in range and active lifetime.
- The revolver will now correctly scale with the critical multiplier upgrade.
- Xbox button prompt 'Y' added to all note pick-ups for controller players with Xbox prompts enabled.
- Fixed a specific instance that would cause weapons not to retain clip capacity upgrades when swapping.
- Fixed the SMG and revolver clip capacity upgrade buttons on the upgrade menu.
- Additional lighting added to the Bull and Elephant chambers in the level: Archdale Castle.
- Boss health bars will no longer remain on screen after death in the level: Archdale Castle.
- Removed out-of-bounds foliage in the level: Archdale Castle.
- Removed collision left behind after triggering the explosion when leaving the level: Cemetery.
- Fixed an issue that caused certain props to disappear in the level: Docks.
- Collision for the Camera adjusted for signs in the level: Garden.
- The revolver mesh will now disappear on pickup as intended.
- Reduced hitbox size on flamethrowers in the Elephant chamber.
- The gate facing the statuette in the Panther chamber will now open after the interaction.
- Difficulty descriptions on the main menu have been adjusted.
- Several SFX fixes.

[u]More content, fixes and improvements are on the way[/u]
I remain active in seeking out player feedback and creating the best experience possible.
Thank you to everyone who has picked up Evil Awaits!

notes.title: Evil Awaits Patch 1.0.3 - Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
[u][b]Several fixes and improvements[/b][/u]
- Skulls Of Archdale gates in the Garden will now trigger on walking into the room when you have enough to unlock, instead of walking up to the pedestals. 
- Weapons equipped before opening a door will now re-equip that weapon at the end of the interaction.
- Weapons equipped before cinematics will be re-equipped upon ending unless a separate weapon is included in the cinematic.
- The mouse will no longer have a chance to appear on the screen when leaving the pause menu on Keyboard and Mouse.
- First Person Aiming no longer has the pitch inverted for Gamepad / Controller.

[u]More fixes and improvements are on the way[/u]
Thank you for all the positive reviews and feedback, each time the player experience improves.

notes.title: Evil Awaits Patch 1.0.2 - Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:

- Headshots & Critical Hits now produce larger blood VFX.
- Headshots & Critical Hits now produce louder SFX.
- The 'Clip Capacity' upgrade for every weapon will no longer increase from re-loading.
- The camera will now be set behind the character when starting a new game.
- The Rank system has been adjusted and is working correctly.
- Fixed the 'Ogre Challenge' achievement.
- Loot crates can now drop Revolver ammo when the Revolver is equipped.
- More loot crates and medkits added to the level: Archdale Castle.
- More Toolkits added to the levels: Garden and Archdale Castle.
- Keybind options disabled, they will be enabled in a later update once fixed and tested.
- Crates no longer block any optional paths in the Docks when reloading after defeating the boss.
- Sliding will no longer create irregular movements for the camera.

[u] More fixes and improvements are on the way[/u]
I remain dedicated to bringing the best experience to everyone who is facing the mysteries of Archdale.
Look forward to more updates very soon!

notes.title: Evil Awaits Release
notes.notes:
[b]Evil Awaits releases today (22/10/2024) at 2PM BST![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/00384216f878aa2c9bef830f021b4e2ef527f0b5.png[/img]

[u]A message from the solo developer of Evil Awaits:[/u]
2 years ago today the demo for Evil Awaits participated in Steams Next Fest Oct 2022, and since then the game has come a long way in its scope, mechanics, environments, story and so much more. 

Despite not receiving crowdfunding back then, Evil Awaits has been developed through pure passion and dedication. I would like to thank everyone that played the demo 2 years ago, wishlisted the game since then, and encouraged the development of Evil Awaits.

With the game being made by 1 developer and a very small team of playtesters. I ask that you remain patient as fixes, improvements, and additional content are rolled out over the upcoming weeks based on your player experiences.

I can't wait to see how you will tackle the challenges and unravel the story of Archdale.
Thank you for being a part of Evil Awaits journey, it's not over yet.
